title: The Concept of Other Minds
text:
Philosophy grapples with the 'problem of other minds,' questioning how knowledge of consciousness can be derived from another being. This problem posits that even when observing complex behavior, internal subjective experience—qualia—remains inaccessible to observation.

Thought experiments often highlight the asymmetry between self-knowledge and knowledge of others. While introspection provides direct access to one's own mental state, this privileged access does not extend beyond the boundaries of the individual subject.
